title: Who Has the Final Say? Conformity Dynamics in ChatGPT’s Selections
reasoning: The paper investigates the psychological phenomenon of social conformity in GPT-4o. It uses an experimental hiring context to see how the model responds to social influence and pressure. While it discusses 'normative conformity' (a psychological term for adapting to social expectations) and the risks of unfairness in high-stakes decision-making, it does not evaluate religious, moral, or ethical frameworks or reasoning systems directly.
